template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_transferable_atom: High-density reference can be the product
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_cognitive_job: Package a dense but recurring body of knowledge into a reference readers can repeatedly consult.
candidate_reader_states: desire to feel more fluent at work
candidate_information_grammar: group items by a usable logic
make the reference retrievable at a glance
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_caption_job: Explain scope, provenance, use boundary and the one practical reason the reader should keep the reference.
candidate_use_when: The information is durable and consulted repeatedly.
There is a defensible grouping logic.
Compression preserves rather than distorts the meaning.
candidate_do_not_use_when: The reader needs one deep causal explanation.
The list is arbitrary or too broad to be reliable.
A single decision tool would be more useful than a compendium.
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_reverse_build_specification: When a chosen opportunity contains durable, repeat-use knowledge, create a compact field guide with an explicit scope and repeated retrieval pattern. Make every row earn its place, make grouping visible, and state what the guide cannot decide for the reader.
template_assisted_hypotheses.topic_selection_boundary: This template does not select a future topic, audience, factual claim or post angle.
template_assisted_hypotheses.required_next_step: Inspect the local asset and write record-specific evidence before promoting any candidate field into a manual forensic record or Creative Genome retrieval.
